name: portfolio-cms
description: The 29 Work cards use individual generated 3D pixel concept covers (`thumb-3d-*.webp`). Original client artwork remains on each project detail page. `work-thumbnails.json` maps each project to its cover; `work-thumbnail-prompts.json` records the scene briefs. Run `python apply-work-thumbnails.py` to reapply the covers after a content rebuild. The portfolio, UTMB and Tilda generators also preserve this mapping automatically.
